email.subject: Pearl Co Dentistry: quick site fix list
email.body:
Hi Sam,

I took a quick look at Pearl Co Dentistry's site. A couple things are likely costing you new patients: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors searching "dentist near me" can't tap to call without hunting for a number, and the site isn't mobile-friendly, which makes it hard to use on a phone at all - that's where most local searches happen. It also has no online booking, no reviews shown, and no listed hours, all of which make people bounce to a competitor's site instead.

I fix these for a flat fee, no retainer. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change - no pitch, just the list.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
